## Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? Who is affected, and what is the current
pain point or gap? Reference the mission/compliance driver where applicable.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the desired behavior. Include affected modules (Documents, Audio,
Healthcare Claims, Data Systems, Comparison, Extraction, Automation, TEFCA
Review Protocol, Case Management, Bulletin Intelligence, etc.), API surface, and
any data model or migration implications.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you evaluate, and why is the proposed solution
preferred?

## User Role / Persona

Which RBAC role(s) or persona benefits from this change?
(viewer, contributor, manager, reviewer, senior_analyst, qalead,
program_manager, admin — or an external integration.)

## Compliance / Security Considerations

- Does this feature handle PHI, PII, or CUI? If so, describe minimization,
  masking, encryption, and audit-logging requirements.
- Are new external connectors, dependencies, or data flows involved?
- Relevant frameworks: NIST SP 800-53, HIPAA, OWASP, Section 508.
- Any authentication / authorization (RBAC, JWT, Entra ID SSO) impact?

## Additional Context

Mockups, references, related issues, or supporting detail.
